pricing.title: Plans That
pricing.subtitle: Choose the perfect plan for your business. No hidden fees, no surprises. Start with a 14-day free trial.

pricing.faqQ1: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan at any time?
pricing.faqA1: Yes, you can change your plan at any time. When upgrading, you'll be billed the prorated difference. When downgrading, the new rate applies at the start of your next billing cycle.
pricing.faqQ2: Is there a free trial available?
pricing.faqA2: Yes! All plans come with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required. You can explore all features of your chosen plan during the trial period.
pricing.faqQ3: What payment methods do you accept?
pricing.faqA3: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers for annual plans. All payments are processed securely through Stripe.
pricing.faqA4: Yes, you can cancel anytime. Your access will continue until the end of your current billing period.
pricing.bottomSubtitle: Start with a 14-day free trial on any plan. No credit card required.
pricing.descStarter: Perfect for small businesses getting started.

aboutPage.heroSubtitle: We're on a mission to empower every business with the tools, insights, and automation they need to thrive in the digital age.
aboutPage.missionP1: Dashboard was born from a simple insight: businesses deserve better tools. After years of wrestling with fragmented, disconnected software, our founders set out to build a unified platform that brings everything together.
aboutPage.missionP2: What started as a side project in 2020 has grown into a platform serving thousands of businesses worldwide. We've helped companies increase revenue, streamline operations, and make smarter decisions with data they can trust.
aboutPage.missionP3: Today, we're a team of 50+ passionate people across 15 countries, united by a shared belief that great software can transform how businesses work.
aboutPage.m2020Desc: Founded in a small garage with a big vision to transform business management.
aboutPage.m2021Desc: Hit our first major milestone with 1,000 active businesses using the platform.
aboutPage.m2022Desc: Raised $10M to accelerate product development and expand the team.
aboutPage.m2023Desc: Launched in 30+ countries with multi-language and multi-currency support.
aboutPage.m2024Desc: Introduced AI-driven analytics, predictive forecasting, and smart automation.
aboutPage.m2025Desc: Achieved SOC 2 compliance, 99.99% uptime, and enterprise-grade security.
aboutPage.valuesSubtitle: The principles that guide every decision we make and every product we build.
aboutPage.v1Desc: We push the boundaries of what's possible, constantly iterating and improving our platform to deliver cutting-edge solutions.
aboutPage.v2Desc: Your data is sacred. We employ enterprise-grade security measures, encryption, and compliance standards to keep your business safe.
aboutPage.v3Desc: Every feature, every decision starts with our users. We listen, learn, and build what businesses actually need to succeed.
aboutPage.v4Desc: Built for businesses of every size, across every timezone. Our platform handles millions of transactions across 50+ countries.
aboutPage.v5Desc: We grow with our customers. Continuous improvement, data-driven decisions, and relentless pursuit of excellence drive everything we do.
aboutPage.v6Desc: Behind every great product is a great team. We invest in our people, foster inclusion, and build a culture where everyone thrives.
aboutPage.teamSubtitle: The people driving innovation and building the future of business management.
aboutPage.teamMore: And 40+ more amazing people across 15 countries
aboutPage.ctaDesc: Join thousands of businesses already using Dashboard to manage, analyze, and grow.

featuresPage.heroSubtitle: From real-time analytics to team collaboration — explore all the tools that make Dashboard the ultimate business management platform.
featuresPage.g1Desc: Make data-driven decisions with powerful analytics and real-time dashboards.
featuresPage.g1f1Desc: Real-time overview of your key metrics including revenue, orders, customers, and product performance. Auto-refreshes every 15 seconds.
featuresPage.g1f2Desc: Interactive revenue charts with monthly breakdowns, trend analysis, and channel distribution. Hover for detailed tooltips.
featuresPage.g1f3Desc: Comprehensive sales reports with channel breakdown, customer summaries, and product performance.
featuresPage.g1f4Desc: Track performance across 6+ sales channels including Online Store, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and Shopify.
featuresPage.g2Desc: Efficiently manage your orders and build stronger customer relationships.
featuresPage.g2f1Desc: View and manage orders from all sales channels in one unified interface. Track status, payment, and shipping at a glance.
featuresPage.g2f2Desc: Detailed customer profiles with order history, spending totals, and contact information.
featuresPage.g2f3Desc: Monitor stock levels across your product catalog with real-time inventory updates and low-stock alerts.
featuresPage.g2f4Desc: Track order fulfillment from placement to delivery with a visual timeline showing each status change.
featuresPage.g3Desc: Drive growth with powerful marketing tools and promotional features.
featuresPage.g3f1Desc: Create, track, and analyze marketing campaigns across channels. Monitor performance metrics and ROI.
featuresPage.g3f2Desc: Create and manage discount codes, promotional offers, and seasonal pricing.
featuresPage.g3f3Desc: Track growth metrics across revenue, customers, orders, and products with percentage changes.
featuresPage.g3f4Desc: Export orders, customers, and reports to CSV with full UTF-8 support.
featuresPage.g4Desc: Collaborate effectively with your team while keeping your data secure.
featuresPage.g4f1Desc: Granular permissions with Admin, Manager, and Staff roles. Control access across all sections.
featuresPage.g4f2Desc: Add team members, assign roles, and manage access permissions.
featuresPage.g4f3Desc: Server-Sent Events deliver instant updates across all connected clients.
featuresPage.g4f4Desc: Complete activity log tracking every action taken in the system.
featuresPage.perfSubtitle: Every feature is designed to be fast, reliable, and intuitive.
featuresPage.perf1Desc: Database queries optimized under 50ms. Pages render in under 100ms.
featuresPage.perf2Desc: Distributed infrastructure with automatic failover. Zero planned downtime.
featuresPage.perf3Desc: Server-Sent Events push updates across all connected clients instantly.
featuresPage.ctaDesc: Start your 14-day free trial. No credit card required.

ai.rateLimitWhyBody: The AI provider's free tier allows only a limited number of requests per day per model. When that daily budget runs out, the provider answers with a “rate limited” (429) response instead of generating a reply. The countdown waits for the provider's suggested window, then your question is re-sent automatically — or you can retry now manually.
